messages:
Maria S: Quick standup for AtlasPilot - customer hit auth errors after SAML config change, blocking demo. Details below.
Sam SE: Can you paste logs?
Jamal (custeng): Repro steps:
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -> 401 {"error":"unauthorized","reason":"missing_scope:inference"}
Lee (oncall): That looks like service returning 401, could be token scope. Also seeing intermittent 429s in last 30m. Snippets:
```
2026-03-21T15:02:12Z ERROR 401 authz: token missing scope 'inference'
2026-03-21T15:03:03Z WARN 429 rate_limit: client=atlas-trial, reqs=350/s
```
Tara (security): Customer's SecQ requires SAML metadata + IDP cert fingerprint. Did they upload metadata to the console?
Olivia CSM: They completed the questionnaire but left the 'audience claim' Q blank.
Sam SE: Ok we need to check: 1) Confirm the token issuer claim matches 'redwood' 2) Confirm SAML audience is the client-app id 3) Add explicit scope mapping in authz policy.
Maria S: Customer asking if this will need Dedicated to avoid rate limits; what's the quick answer on pricing/downtime?
Sam SE: Short answer: if sustained throughput > 250 req/s and strict SLAs, Dedicated monthly commit recommended; we can also give a temporary burst quota during the POC to avoid demo fallout.
Jamal (custeng): For immediate unblock can you add temporary policy to map SAML assertion->inference scope? I can ask customer to re-run after they upload metadata.
Lee (oncall): Oncall can add a rate-limit exemption for demo traffic for the next 2 hours (need SG approval). @Tara any security concerns with temporary scope mapping?
Tara (security): Temporary mapping ok if we log and revoke after. Need a ticket and signed addendum. Also require the customer accepts audit logs being shared.
Maria S: I'll get the signed addendum. Olivia, can you coordinate? cc @Jamal (custeng)
Olivia CSM: On it, sending the addendum now. Also scheduling an 11:30am standup to confirm progress.
DeployBot: Deploy queued: authz-policy patch v2.3 -> staging (assigned to Lee) :rocket:
Lee (oncall): Patching now, will monitor. If 401 persists escalate to infra.
Sam SE: If 429 persists, fallback plan: route some demo traffic to a smaller model variant (lower throughput but guaranteed response) and show latency/cost metrics so demo still works.
Maria S: Thanks team. Next steps: Tara approve temp mapping, Lee patch, Olivia get addendum signed, Jamal confirm customer re-run, Sam prep fallback demo. I'll update the deal thread and loop in AE for contract.
Olivia CSM: +1, will post a timestamped note after addendum is signed.
Jamal (custeng): Quick update — customer re-ran with new SAML metadata, now 200 OK for generator. :tada:
Maria S: Amazing — please grab logs and confirm no regression.
Lee (oncall): Monitoring: 200s steady; 429s dropped to normal. Closing this standup. I'll file a short postmortem if there are followups.
Maria S: Closing — thanks everyone :heart:
